artifacts.purpose: Private tagged DTOs and recursive duplicate-key rejection

interfaces: Input: exact UTF-8 bytes; output: private wire DTO or typed Error.
Keep tags explicit and unknown fields fatal outside allowed opaque payload/configuration.
Required opaque input distinguishes absent from explicit null; retain arbitrary JSON numeric values.
acceptance_criteria: Duplicate keys fail before overwrite at every nesting depth including input and source configuration.
Unknown tags/fields, wrong primitive types, and unsupported wire versions fail safely.
Numeric spelling remains in snapshots; input integer 9007199254740993 survives decode/inspection without binary64 rounding.

verification.expected: Escaped-equivalent keys and nested duplicate keys are rejected.
Large integer preserved; explicit null legal; missing input rejected.
Unknown fields/types/wire version are rejected without inference.

verification_responsibility: A different agent from the implementation author reruns evidence and reviews every acceptance criterion; integrator accepts only the saved response.
